label: WATCH
rationale: REVISED AGAIN 2026-09-04 after 삼성전자 사업보고서 제57기 (FY2025, tier-1). Score 68 to 69 (Starter / Watch). Label, Hard Veto status and position band unchanged - but the REASON is now much better evidenced and the call is less of a coin-flip than at the prior revision. THE DECISIVE ADDITION is the DS segment series the primary gate had been asking for: operating margin of -22.3% in FY2023 (an outright KRW 14.88T LOSS), 13.6% FY2024, 19.1% FY2025, 68.3% H1 2026 - roughly a KRW 158T swing in half-year-equivalent profit within three years. Combined with ASP compounding (+14% in FY2025, +220% in H1 2026, roughly 3.65x FY2024 in eighteen months), a first-pass normalised model can finally be built. On deliberately generous assumptions - DS revenue of KRW 250-300T at a 30-38% margin, well above any prior mid-cycle level - it produces group normalised operating profit of KRW 93-132T against a price requirement of KRW 145-183T. THE EXPECTATION GAP IS THEREFORE NEGATIVE, NOT MERELY THIN. That is a change in kind from the prior two revisions, which described it as tight. expectation_gap_and_valuation cut 6/15 to 5/15 and the bear weight raised 0.30 to 0.35; probability-weighted five-year return falls from +14.9% to roughly +8.4% total, or 1.6% annualised. CUTTING THE OTHER WAY, and genuinely: cumulative cancellation of 24.9% of all common shares ever issued, across many cycles rather than this one, materially offsets the 'buying at the peak' criticism. And FY2025 investment of KRW 90.4T (capex 52.65 + R&D 37.75) against KRW 43.6T of operating profit - sustained through the FY2023 DS loss - is counter-cyclical reinvestment of a quality this strategy is built to reward. Categories 4 (12 to 13) and 5 (7 to 8) raised. The business is now confirmed better than three successive reviews had credited; the price is confirmed worse. WATCH with band NONE is retained, and unlike the prior revision this is no longer a close call on subjective weights - the normalised model lands below the requirement on assumptions already tilted in the company's favour. Note the gate is closed against the current PRICE, not against the company: at DS revenue near KRW 320T and a margin above 40% the requirement is met. ADDENDUM after the FY2025 별도재무제표 (pp.194-199, filing screenshots). Score held at 69 and verdict unchanged. Three findings. FOR: parent capex fell 16.2% across FY2023-25 (KRW 45.03T to 37.75T) while parent operating cash flow doubled - the capex discipline is a three-year pattern, not one half-year - and SBC is quantified at a small KRW 0.71T in FY2025, closing a long-standing data gap. AGAINST, and more important: FY2023 produced a parent operating LOSS of KRW 11.53T and a group segment sum near KRW 6.25T, roughly a 47x swing from the current annualised run-rate. The modelled bear of KRW 70-90T normalised operating profit is the MODAL bear, not the tail. Bear return worsened to -55/-45 and the weighted five-year return falls from +8.4% to roughly +5.5% total, or 1.1% annualised. Note also that the capex discipline is two-edged: Samsung's own underinvestment across FY2023-25 is part of why the current shortage exists, and the projected tripling of industry capex into 2027 is the correction of it. Category 4 was NOT raised to 14 despite supporting evidence, because it has already moved 10 to 12 to 13 across prior updates and the red team's one-directional-revision critique applies symmetrically to upward moves. Decision confidence rises 0.72 to 0.76 - a fourth tier-1 document has now reconciled to the won against the previous three, and the expected-return conclusion has survived each of them. PRICE UPDATE (KRW 255,500, user-supplied): required normalised operating profit rises to KRW 150-188T against an unchanged model output of KRW 93-132T, widening the shortfall to roughly KRW 18-95T; weighted five-year return falls to +4.0% total (0.8%/yr). Nothing about the business changed. Per policy/monitoring.yaml and policy/position-sizing.yaml, price movement alone neither creates nor removes a position, so the verdict is unchanged and the scorecard was not re-scored on a 2.2% tick. For completeness in the other direction, computed rather than asserted: the common price at which the required normalised operating profit meets the KRW 93-132T model range is roughly KRW 142,000-232,000 across the model bounds and an 8-10x mid-cycle EV/EBIT, with a central estimate near KRW 183,700 (9x on the KRW 112.5T model midpoint) - about 28% below KRW 255,500. Computed on the MEASURED preferred/common ratio of 0.7205. That is the price at which the expectation gap turns positive with no change in business evidence. CORRECTION: an earlier draft of this rationale stated KRW 150,000-165,000; that figure was written without being computed and was wrong. PREFERRED PRICE RESOLVED (005935 at KRW 184,100): the last unverified valuation input in the file is now closed. The measured preferred discount of 27.9% is far wider than the 14.0% assumed, cutting total equity value to KRW 1,641.44T and EV to KRW 1,473.90T, and lifting the weighted five-year return to +5.8% (1.1%/yr). Verdict, veto status, band and score are all unchanged — a 1.7% input revision does not move a category that already reflects a clearly negative gap. Worth recording that this is the first valuation input in the file to resolve in the company's favour.
increase_evidence: PRIMARY, RESTATED: the normalised model must be raised above roughly KRW 145T of group operating profit on defensible assumptions - which requires either disclosed multi-year capacity-reserved HBM contract terms, or evidence that normalised DS margin sustains above 40% on revenue near KRW 320T. Absent that, price must fall to meet the KRW 93-132T range.

PRIMARY: a completed normalised mid-cycle model of DS operating profit against announced 2027-2029 industry capacity additions, now anchorable on the measured baseline of DS operating margin 13.6% (FY2024) / 19.1% (FY2025) / 68.3% (H1 2026). This closes incremental_roic_collapse and is the prerequisite for any position.

HBM share holding at or above 33% in Q3 and Q4 2026 AFTER SK hynix's HBM4 reaches mass production - this distinguishes a durable technology lead from a temporary allocation shift during a competitor's stumble.

Confirmation at the January 2027 board that a material portion of the KRW 90-110T return is delivered as buyback-and-cancel rather than dividend, with cancellations exceeding the KRW 15T employee-compensation buyback.
Foundry reaching sustained quarterly operating profit with a second large external logic customer beyond Tesla at Taylor.
Evidence that HBM contract structure genuinely dampens cycle amplitude - multi-year, capacity-reserved, price-fixed agreements disclosed rather than inferred.
A verified preferred-share price and consolidated net cash position that materially lower the true equity value or EV versus the estimates used here.

Price weakness that widens the gap WITHOUT any deterioration in the above business evidence. Per policy/position-sizing.yaml, price decline alone is never sufficient - it must accompany improving business evidence.
Memory ASP stabilising rather than continuing to spike - a further price surge raises the rent being capitalised and makes the eventual reversion worse, not better.

Full-year capex landing near the H1 run-rate (roughly KRW 62-70T annualised) rather than stepping up toward the announced KRW 110T+ programme, confirming that H1 restraint is policy rather than timing.
reduce_or_exit_evidence: HBM share reversing back toward the low 20s once SK hynix HBM4 volume arrives, which would recast the Q2 2026 gain as a competitor stumble rather than a Samsung advance and flip the moat_shrinkage veto to INVESTIGATE.
DRAM or HBM contract prices rolling over while the US$146B of 2027 industry capex is still being spent - the classic signature of an incremental-ROIC collapse in progress.
Capex guidance rising further while operating cash flow falls, or any move to fund the return programme with debt.
The January 2027 board delivering the return predominantly as dividend while employee-compensation buybacks continue, leaving net share count flat or rising.
Foundry breakeven slipping again, or a Taylor write-down.
CXMT demonstrating credible leading-edge DRAM at volume, which would convert the three-player oligopoly assumption underlying every scenario here into a four-player one.
Any evidence contradicting the management_or_accounting_integrity PASS.
Capex stepping up sharply in H2 2026 or 2027 toward the announced KRW 110T+ programme while memory ASP rolls over - the combination that would confirm the incremental_roic_collapse thesis.
DX operating margin failing to recover as memory normalises, which would remove the internal hedge that raises the bear floor.
DS revenue or margin tracking toward the FY2024-25 range (13.6-19.1%) faster than the normalised model assumes, which would put group operating profit below even the KRW 93T lower bound.
Any evidence of a genuine oversupply forming, given the FY2023 precedent of a parent operating LOSS - the downside is not bounded by the modelled KRW 70-90T normalised range.
